description: Post a reply on an existing support ticket, adding it to the conversation for the support team. Use list_tickets or get_ticket first to read the thread and get the ticket id. Replying never closes a ticket.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be posted to the ticket and getting their approval.

message.description: The reply text to post on the ticket.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id from list_tickets or get_ticket.

name: reply_to_ticket
title: Reply To Support Ticket
